title: ValueStreamCatalogue
description: Reference schema for catalogue/_value-streams.yaml. Value streams are an artefact orthogonal to the capability hierarchy: each stream describes an end-to-end flow whose stages link to L1 capabilities (`capability_ids`) and to business processes that realize the work (`process_ids`).

id.description: Stable identifier for the value stream. Sparse 10/20/30 numbering so insertions never renumber siblings.

name.description: Display name. Outcome-focused, hyphenated bookend pattern (e.g. Order-to-Cash, Hire-to-Retire).

description.description: Outcome-oriented summary of the end-to-end flow (1-3 sentences).

industries.description: Industry applicability. 'Cross-Industry' must stand alone when present; otherwise list one or more specific industries from the catalogue's L1 vocabulary.

metadata.description: Escape hatch for governance fields not yet promoted to first-class.

id.description: Stable stage identifier in the form <stream-id>.<n> with sparse 10/20/30 numbering.

stage_order.description: 1-based ordinal position of the stage within the stream. Multiple stages may share an order when industry variants split a logical step.

capability_ids.description: L1 capabilities exercised at this stage. Stages link at L1 only; the site auto-expands to descendants when filtering. Use 'notes' to capture sub-scope detail.

process_ids.description: Business processes that realize the work at this stage. May be empty during rollout while the BP catalogue is being populated.

industries.description: Optional override of the parent stream's industries for this stage. Inherited if absent.

industry_variant.description: Optional industry-specific variant label distinguishing this stage from the cross-industry baseline (e.g. 'Healthcare Providers').

description.description: Optional longer description of the stage.

notes.description: Free-form notes — typically sub-scope of the linked capability or stage-specific commentary.
